preconditions.description: The number of factories is between 1 and 500,000.
The number of businessmen is between 1 and 500,000.
The number of years is between 1 and 500,000.
The dependency tree is a rooted tree with each node dependent on exactly one node with a lower index.
Each factory is owned by a businessman.
The threshold money for each businessman is between 1 and 10^18.
The factory number is between 1 and N.
The donation amount is between 1 and 1,000,000.
The increment amount is between 0 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: For each businessman, the output is either 'rekt' if he never earns his desired amount or the year he first earns it.
